name: agent-hub
description: Use one Agent Hub MCP for LLM-planned adaptive workflows, cross-model consistency, shared memory, and Git-artifact handoff in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and run consistent multi-model workflows
interface.longDescription: Agent Hub lets Codex use Claude, Grok, Gemini, and GPT through one provider-neutral MCP, decompose goals into validated dependency DAGs, run independent steps concurrently, and fail closed on policy, provider, or decision disagreement. Shared memory and Git handoffs keep work portable across host apps.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Hub to plan this task, show which steps can run concurrently, then execute the reviewed plan
Compare the default Claude, Grok, and Gemini set with a fail-closed consistency gate; use provider=all when GPT should participate
